description: The line plot illustrates the relative change in performance across different layers of a model, comparing various token-precision configurations against a baseline. The x-axis represents the model layers, grouped into segments: Layer1-12, Layer13-20, Layer21-28, and Layer29, with each segment corresponding to a range of layers. The y-axis measures the relative change in performance, expressed as a percentage, ranging from -15% to 5%, with a dashed horizontal line at 0% indicating no change. Four distinct lines are plotted: a yellow line with circular markers representing "LB-Avg of 2×tokens,8-bit," a red line with square markers for "LB-Avg of 2×tokens,8-bit," a light blue line with circular markers for "RULER4k of 2×tokens,8-bit," and a dark blue line with square markers for "RULER4k of 1×tokens,4-bit." The yellow line starts at approximately 1% relative change for Layer1-12, increases to around 3% for Layer13-20, and then rises further to about 4% for Layer21-28 before slightly decreasing to around 3.5% for Layer29. The red line begins at approximately 2% for Layer1-12, decreases to about 1% for Layer13-20, and then increases to around 3% for Layer21-28 before slightly decreasing to about 2.5% for Layer29. The light blue line starts at approximately 1% for Layer1-12, decreases to around -2% for Layer13-20, and then increases to about 3% for Layer21-28 before slightly decreasing to around 2.5% for Layer29. The dark blue line starts at approximately -2% for Layer1-12, decreases to around -15% for Layer13-20, and then increases to about 2% for Layer21-28 before slightly decreasing to around 1% for Layer29. The dashed gray line at 0% serves as a reference for no change in performance.
